question: What did the Battle of Belonia show about how the war was fought in the southeast?

options.text: Border geography around a salient near the Tripura frontier was used to pressure Pakistani positions
It was decided by naval commando strikes at river ports
No pressure was put on Pakistani positions near the border

explanation: At Belonia, Mukti Bahini and Indian forces used the border salient near Tripura to open routes and weaken Pakistani control in the southeast before the final campaign.
